about_the_game:
A Deer and Fawn must embark on a journey through an abandoned world of the unknown to get home.

Gifted a power of light, the Deer and Fawn power through environments seeped in oil.
Clean through the mess left behind and discover new sparks.

-explore a handcraft world
-linear, short game experience
-fawn companion
-grow your light

a third person adventure game by ant tan.
Featuring soundtrack from aivi & surasshu, composers for the show Steven Universe.
detailed_description:
We Won Something!


I'm cheesed to announce that the 30 minute playable demo we brought to SXSW won the 'People's Choice Award' !
I'm so glad that once it was in the hands of players, they actually had a good time with the game. I'd love to polish it up some more and get it online - but regretably I missed next-fest... Maybe there'll be another opportunity?


Come check us out at SXSW Sydney, 2025!



Wow! They're updating the Steam Page for an amazing reason...

I'm showcasing a super exciting demo of 'wttw' at SXSW Sydney, from the 14th-18th (Wed-Sat). Saturday is free, so please come by and check us out! Does this look official and cool or what?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 | AMD FX-6350
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you can run fortnite you can run way to the woods
